column1: # The API is auth-gated — every endpoint returns 401 JSON without a bearer
# token — so header/meta-level informational alerts are expected noise, not
# findings. These IDs are IGNOREd so the baseline stays deterministic on a
# JSON-only API that sets no browser-facing headers by design.
# FORMAT (current zap-baseline parser): at least 3 TAB-separated tokens per
# data line: <rule-id> <action> <description>. Lines with fewer tokens fail
# with "Unexpected number of tokens on line - there should be at least 3,
# tab separated". Full-line '#' comments are allowed.
